ev.q: Among unvaccinated patients, those with immunocompromise had higher odds of ICU admission
Among the 22,345 patients included, 12.2% were immunocompromised
Among unvaccinated patients, those who were immunocompromised had higher odds of ICU admission (aOR = 1.26)
Multivariable analyses were adjusted for age, sex, site (entered as a fixed effect)
COVID-NET is a CDC-funded collaboration for population-based surveillance of laboratory-confirmed COVID-19–associated hospitalization

methods_quotes.q: Bivariate and multivariable logistic regression analyses were used to assess associations between immunocompromise and both ICU admission and in-hospital death
Associations between each individual immunocompromising condition and death were assessed using multivariable analyses, adjusting only for age and sex to improve model convergence.
Pearson’s chi-square tests were used to compare differences between immunocompromised and nonimmunocompromised patients.
Statistical analyses used SAS (version 9.4; SAS Institute) survey procedures to account for sampling weights, with statistical significance set at alpha = 0.05.
